service: Updating and Issuance of Tax Declaration (Transferred Properties)
description: Updates property records and issues a new Tax Declaration when ownership of a Calamba City property has been transferred through sale, extrajudicial settlement, donation, adjudication, or other legal means.
whoMayAvail: All property owners and administrators in Calamba City

detailedRequirements.requirement: Current Land Title (certified copy or copy from Original Title)
Notarized Deed of Transfer (Deed of Sale / Extrajudicial Settlement / Adjudication / Donation / Partition, etc.) with notarized supporting affidavits
Transfer Tax Receipt
Tax Declaration Receipt / Certificate Authorizing Registration (CAR)
Special Power of Attorney / Authorization Letter / Secretary's Certificate / Board Resolution with valid IDs
Approved Subdivision / Consolidation Plan — if there is a change in land area (conditional)
Business Permit / License — if commercial or business establishment (conditional)
DAR Certificate — if agricultural land; NIA Clearance — if irrigated farm lot (conditional)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) / National Irrigation Administration (NIA)

detailedRequirements.requirement: Affidavit of Non-tenancy — if agricultural lot (conditional)

clientSteps.action: Submit photocopies of required documents and present originals for verification.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review documents. If complete: issue Order of Payment, process the declaration, and conduct inspection, review, and assessment. If incomplete: return documents to client.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Accept payment and issue Official Receipt.

clientSteps.action: Present Official Receipt and claim the document.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the new Tax Declaration.

notes: Document may be claimed within three (3) working days as it requires review and assessment by the concerned personnel. If the property is to be consolidated, subdivided, or segregated, processing continues under Service No. 2 (Issuance of New Tax Declaration for General Purposes).

service: Issuance of New Tax Declaration for General Purposes
plainLanguageName: New Tax Declaration (New Buildings, Machinery, or Improvements)
description: Issues a new Tax Declaration for newly constructed buildings, newly installed machinery, or new improvements on real property in Calamba City, including cases of lot subdivision or consolidation.
officeDivision: City Assessment Office — Appraisal & Assessment Division
whoMayAvail: All property owners and administrators in Calamba City

detailedRequirements.requirement: Request Letter / Authorization Letter with valid ID
Building Permit / Occupancy Permit / Building Plan / Bill of Materials / Certificate of Completion
Zoning Certificate / Clearance
List of Machinery with Acquisition & Installation Cost and Date
Authorization / SPA / Secretary's Certificate with valid IDs

clientSteps.action: Submit photocopies of required documents and present originals for verification.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review documents. If complete: issue Order of Payment, process, and conduct inspection, review, and assessment. If incomplete: return documents to client.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Accept payment and issue Official Receipt.

clientSteps.action: Present Official Receipt and claim the document.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the new Tax Declaration.

notes: Document may be claimed within seven (7) working days as it requires inspection, review, and assessment by the concerned personnel.

service: Issuance of Certified True Copy of Tax Declaration / Certificate of Aggregate Land Holdings / Certificate of No Property
plainLanguageName: Certified Copy of Tax Declaration or Property Certificate
description: Issues certified true copies of existing Tax Declarations, Certificates of Aggregate Land Holdings, or Certificates of No Property on record — commonly required for real estate transactions, bank loans, and legal proceedings.
officeDivision: City Assessment Office — Appraisal & Assessment Division
whoMayAvail: All property owners and administrators in Calamba City

detailedRequirements.requirement: Authorization Letter with valid ID
Tax Receipt or Land Title
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: City Treasury Office or Registry of Deeds

clientSteps.action: Submit the request and required documents.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the request, issue Order of Payment, process the request, and affix annotation seals.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Accept payment and issue Official Receipt.

clientSteps.action: Present Official Receipt and claim the document.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the certified true copy of the requested document.

description: Certifies that a real property in Calamba City has no declared building, structure, or improvement on record with the City Assessment Office. Commonly required for real estate transactions and legal purposes.
whoMayAvail: All property owners and administrators in Calamba City

detailedRequirements.requirement: Request Letter / Authorization Letter with valid ID
Tax Receipt of the property

clientSteps.action: Submit the written request and required documents.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review documents, issue Order of Payment, then conduct inspection, review, and assessment.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Accept payment and issue Official Receipt.

clientSteps.action: Present Official Receipt and claim the certified document.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the Certificate of No Improvement.

plainLanguageName: Cancellation of Declared Improvement or Machinery on Tax Record
description: Removes a declared improvement or machinery from a real property's tax record when such improvement or machinery no longer exists or has been disposed of.
whoMayAvail: All property owners and administrators in Calamba City

detailedRequirements.requirement: Authorization Letter with valid IDs
Written request letter for cancellation of the declared improvement or machinery
Proof of cancellation of the real estate property record

clientSteps.action: Submit the cancellation request letter and required documents.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review documents, then process the request (review, inspection, and assessment).

clientSteps.action: Receive the Inspection and Cancellation Report.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the Inspection and Cancellation Report.

notes: Document may be claimed within seven (7) working days as it requires review, inspection, and assessment by the concerned personnel.

description: Verifies and identifies the exact location of a real property in Calamba City using the City Assessment Office's tax mapping records. Useful for property owners who need to confirm a lot's physical location.
officeDivision: City Assessment Office — Tax Mapping Operations Division
whoMayAvail: All property owners and administrators in Calamba City

detailedRequirements.requirement: Authorization Letter with valid IDs
Copy of the Land Title

clientSteps.action: Inform the office of the request and submit required documents.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Verify and locate the property on the tax map, then present the identified property to the client.
clientSteps.processing_time: 10 minutes (5 min verification + 5 min per lot)
